what: A booking button bar fixed at the screen bottom is hidden on the first screen, then rises straight up and brightens as you scroll, fully in place after one screen height. Progress is a view timeline (entry 0→exit 100%) flowing as if the bar were an ordinary element at that spot: until 20% it stays transparent and 20px down, and from 20→100% it goes to opacity 1 and rises into place (no curve, tied linearly to scroll)

options.--fx-y: Distance down to the 20% point (CSS variable), default 20px

note: Runs on CSS animation-timeline: view() with no JS (as in the original). Progress = (scroll + screen height − element top) ÷ (screen height + element height), so even the same band finishes at a different scroll if its height differs (100px band on a 900px screen → 900px, 12px tag → 856px). Browsers without this feature show it from the start
